scope: Nineteenth bounded target-specific wave: eight current completion-unproved eMAR targets; two direct medication benchmark recommendations and six conservative retained-unproved outcomes.

methodology.runtime_boundary: No application, browser, database, deployment or product Git state was changed.
methodology.no_copy_rule: Evidence is behavioural only; do not copy source, schema, UI, wording or distinctive layouts.
methodology.direct_rule: A recommendation requires target-specific neutral job alignment at pinned official community-source loci; generic fields or adjacent medication primitives remain unproved.
methodology.reuse_rule: Shared repositories and previously cited medication-administration source do not grant family credit. Each accepted target is bounded to its own administration-record or prescription-lifecycle job.

BAHMNI_MEDICATION_ADMINISTRATION.edition_boundary: Pinned official community source only; hosted services, private configuration and unpinned behavior are excluded.

OPENEMR.edition_boundary: Pinned official community source only; hosted services, private configuration and unpinned behavior are excluded.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Write an authorized patient/order-bound dose administration with performer, status, time, dose, route, site and notes.
evaluations.research_candidate: Bahmni/openmrs-module-medicationadministration administration model and DAO at pinned loci
evaluations.reason: The authorized administration-record write is directly scoped to patient, drug order, performer, status/reason, time, dose, route, site and notes. The claim is limited to the neutral dose-administration job.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Persist medication-order creation and update state while carrying its linked medication-list active/inactive lifecycle.
evaluations.research_candidate: openemr/openemr prescription persistence at pinned loci
evaluations.reason: OpenEMR persists prescription create/update timing and updates the linked medication-list active/inactive state. This directly benchmarks the bounded medication-order lifecycle job.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Create an immutable, attributable medication-administration correction request linked to the original record and reason.
evaluations.research_candidate: Bahmni administration create/update source at pinned loci
evaluations.reason: Generic create/update does not establish correction-request provenance, original-record linkage, rationale, dedicated state or governed handoff.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Approve or reject a correction through an independent decision with rationale and terminal provenance.
evaluations.research_candidate: Bahmni administration create/update source at pinned loci
evaluations.reason: The candidate does not establish a distinct approve/reject decision, independent reviewer or decision provenance.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Verify or reject a medication order through an independently accountable clinical decision lifecycle.
evaluations.research_candidate: openemr/openemr prescription persistence at pinned loci
evaluations.reason: Prescription persistence and active-list transition do not prove a verify/reject lifecycle with reviewer identity and decision provenance.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Link a PRN dose to a subsequent effectiveness observation and accountable review.
evaluations.research_candidate: Bahmni administration model at pinned loci
evaluations.reason: Administration status, reason and notes are not a PRN dose-to-effectiveness observation and review workflow.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Generate, assign, start and complete a governed medication round with locked items and round-level provenance.
evaluations.research_candidate: Bahmni administration model and DAO at pinned loci
evaluations.reason: No inspected candidate provides round generation, assignment, lifecycle, locked items or round-level operational provenance.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Govern versioned medication-round template creation, update and retirement.
evaluations.research_candidate: Bahmni administration model and DAO at pinned loci
evaluations.reason: No candidate provides a round-template aggregate or governed versioned configuration lifecycle.
